summary: Practical guide for tubed pumps: changing the reservoir and cannula while the pump is disconnected in AAPS, priming and recording the change in Prime/Fill, deleting boluses that were not delivered, disconnecting for showers or sport, recording insulin given while disconnected, and reconnecting afterwards.

screens.ui_location: Main screen > Loop icon > Running mode

sections.heading: Pumps and cannulas
sections.summary: Page title: handling the pump and cannula day to day.

sections.heading: Changing infusion sets: insulin reservoirs and cannulas
sections.summary: Set changes apply to tubed pumps; patch pumps prime in their own wizard and have no Prime/Fill. Reservoir changes are done on the pump and logged in AAPS.

sections.heading: Guide for changing both the pump reservoir and cannula
sections.summary: Step by step: disconnect the pump from the loop icon, change reservoir and cannula, prime on the pump, record the change and prime the cannula in Prime/Fill, then reconnect.
dialogs: Main screen > Loop icon > Running mode

sections.heading: Useful information concerning insulin/cannula changes
sections.summary: Effects of logging a site change (Autosens reset, status lights), where to set default prime amounts, and that primed insulin and insulin bolused while disconnected are not counted in IOB.

sections.heading: Cannula, infusion site, tubing and/or pump issues
sections.summary: When insulin was not delivered, deleting undelivered boluses from the Carbs and bolus tab of Treatments history, or pausing the loop when the amount is unclear.
dialogs: Main menu > Treatments history > Carbs and bolus

sections.heading: Disconnecting the pump for showering or activity
sections.summary: Disconnecting the pump from the loop icon for a chosen duration, extending it, and reconnecting every two hours to make up for missed basal.
dialogs: Main screen > Loop icon > Running mode

sections.heading: To announce delivered insulin without actually bolusing
sections.summary: Recording insulin given by pen or by the pump while disconnected in the Insulin dialog without delivering it, and backdating it; disconnecting the pump remotely by SMS.

sections.heading: Reconnecting the pump after activity
sections.summary: After a long disconnection, either reconnect and let the loop catch up, or bolus the missing insulin with the bolus wizard and zero carbs.
dialogs: Main screen > Loop icon > Running mode

manual_note: The page names a **Time offset** field in the Insulin dialog; the dialog's field is labelled 'Time' (time). 'Time offset' only appears in the QuickWizard editor.
